verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Pomelo offers tokenization so cards can be enabled in Apple Pay, Google Pay and other wallets, for Visa and Mastercard credit, debit and prepaid cards. Nothing documents treating network tokens as first-class objects: no listing of the tokens on a card, no visibility into which wallet or merchant holds each token, and no way to suspend or revoke a token separately from the PAN. Token creation is an adjacent capability that does not satisfy a token-management story.

support.subject: As a developer, network tokens are first-class — I can see and manage the tokens created for a card, know which wallet or merchant holds them, and revoke them independently of the PAN
